header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, CIRCUIT COURT, MIRPURKHAS
(Muhammad Waseem v/s. Province of Sindh & Ors)
Petitioner: Through Mr. Farhan Ahmed Bozdar Advocate
body: 1. Through instant Petition, the Petitioner has claimed appointment 2. It is the case of the Petitioner that his father was employed in School Education Department Government of Sindh and died while in service on 11.08.2016. Petitioner at the time of death of his father was minor, however on attaining majority, he approached the Respondents to consider his case for appointment but to no avail. Learned Counsel therefore prays for appropriate directions.

3. Learned Additional Advocate General, admits the claim of petitioners however states that Petitioner was required to approach the department within two years time from the death of his father, but he applied late, therefore cannot be considered for appointment. He therefore prayed for dismissal of the petition.

4. It reflected from the record that Petitioner’s father Shah Muhammad Mangrio was PST in School Education Department Government of Sindh and he passed away in year 2016 and at the time of the death of his Father Petitioner’s aged was 13 years. He attained majority on 06.02.2022, and applied for the job within one year time, as such his request was found within time and endorsed by the District Education Officer & Director Schools Education in their office letters dated 10.03.2023 and 08.02.2023 respectively (page 41 - 45 of the petition), as such objection raised latter on is not sustainable under the law.

5. It further transpired from record that Government of Sindh has constituted a committee to consider the cases of children of deceased employees in terms of Rule 11-A of APT Rules. In view of above, this petition is disposed of. The Respondents are directed to place the case of Petitioner before the departmental scrutiny committee and decide the same within a period of 3 months’ time from date of this order.
6. Office is directed to send copy of this Order to the Respondents for compliance.
Judge Judge Order Sheet IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, CIRCUIT COURT, MIRPURKHAS C.P.No.D- 399 of 2026 (Mushahid Hussain v/s. P.O Sindh & Ors)
Before:

Mr. Justice Zulfiqar Ali Sangi Mr. Justice Nisar Ahmed Bhanbhro Petitioner: Through Mr. Mir Muhammad Noohri, Advocate Respondents: Through Mr. Ghulamullah Memon Additional Advocate General Sindh ORDER 1. District Education Officer Primary Mirpurkhas filed reply to the petition taken on record.

3. It is the case of the Petitioner that his father was employed as PST in School Education Department Government of Sindh and died while in service 0n 26.07.2015. Petitioner approached the Respondents to consider his case for appointment but to no avail. Learned Counsel therefore prays for appropriate directions.

4. Learned Additional Advocate General, submits that father of the petitioner passed away in year 2015, and he was required to approach the department within two years but he filed application after the cut off date, therefore, was not entitled for job under deceased quota. He therefore prayed for dismissal of the petition.

5. It reflected from the record that Petitioner’s father Noor Zaman passed away in year 2015 and at the time of his death, the age of the petitioner was 16 years. He attained majority in year 2017, and he applied for appointment but his application was declined being found undated. However per record the request of the Petitioner is found within time, as he has applied within two years time of attaining his majority, the other interpretation of law made by the department is untenable.

6. It further transpired from record that Government of Sindh has constituted a committee to consider the cases of children of deceased employees in terms of Rule 11-A of APT Rules and the said committed has declined the application of Petitioner. In view of above, this petition is disposed of. The Respondents are directed to place the case of Petitioner before the departmental scrutiny committee afresh and decide the same within a period of 3 months’ time from date of this order, in terms of the directions contained herein above.
7. Office is directed to send copy of this Order to the Respondents for compliance.
